VBO:0200452.summary: Affectionate and confident, the Dorset Olde Tyme Bulldogge is described by its register as a dog that enjoys staying close to its owner, resting at their feet or walking beside them. Steve Barnett developed the modern Dorset program in the late 1980s; his dog Lord Horatio Nelson reportedly walked six miles each day.
VBO:0200452.shortDescription: The Dorset Olde Tyme Bulldogge is described as affectionate and confident, enjoying quiet company and walks beside its owner.
